source_snapshot.procedure: Enable the documented PCIe AER settings and use the approved AMD RAS tool with errortype0 to trigger LCRC correctable errors separately at the mapped endpoint and upstream root port.
source_snapshot.criteria: Tool reports correctable PASS and the OS reports the event within the project timeout.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; generic PCIe collection and memory-oriented wording do not prove OCP identity, exact AER source or interface continuity.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires physical OCP-to-BDF mapping, distinct coverage, tool semantics, AER oracle, service isolation and restoration.

old_problem: The source hardcodes one generic endpoint/root-port pair for OCP slot 1~N, leaves the OCP interface and service dependency unmapped, and does not define an exact AER status/source/counter oracle or timeout.
disposition_reason: The engineering intent and safe acceptance semantics are sufficiently defined: LCRC is a PCIe correctable error and the source explicitly requires separate endpoint and root-port stimuli. ED-02/04/19 preserve this OCP identity and its distinction from generic PCIe coverage. Physical slot, BDF, interface, OS and timeout values are runtime project bindings under ED-23, while errortype0 remains vendor-signed input rather than guessed. A parameterized record can therefore remove the review decision without authorizing injection.
decision_basis: Directly read Reliability row56, its AI fields, historical record2457, generic PCIe comparison and next pending row57.
Preserved every OCP slot identity and separate endpoint versus upstream-root-port LCRC checkpoints.
Converted physical slot/BDF/interface/service values into a signed runtime topology manifest instead of fixing or guessing them.
Required PCIe AER correctable status, source ID and counter delta plus link and service continuity; tool PASS alone is insufficient.
No BIOS/HDT change, PCIe injection, reset, rebind or DUT test occurred.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized OCP endpoint and upstream-port LCRC correctable error containment
test_case.purpose: For each required populated OCP slot, prove separately that an LCRC correctable stimulus attributed to its endpoint and upstream root port is logged as a bounded PCIe AER CE without link, interface or dependent-service loss.
required_package: Approved AMD RAS tool/spec package with signed errortype0=LCRC-CE semantics for endpoint and root-port targets
Supported OS and approved event timeout
Independent OOB access and BIOS/HDT/AER restoration runbook
test_case.test_command: For one approved OCP path at a time, re-enumerate and verify the signed physical-slot-to-endpoint/upstream-port map; capture AER, link, interface, service and OS baselines; with independent OOB access apply only approved AER/HDT prerequisites; execute the vendor-signed errortype0 LCRC-CE command first against the endpoint and, after a clean checkpoint, separately against the upstream root port; collect exact source/status/counter deltas; clear the stimulus and restore all changed settings before the next slot.
test_case.expected_result: Each authorized endpoint or root-port checkpoint produces exactly the documented correctable LCRC AER status at the intended source within the approved timeout, increments the expected bounded counter once, produces no uncorrectable/fatal escalation, and leaves link width/speed, device, interface, management path and dependent services healthy after cleanup.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the signed target mapping and command transcript, exact AER CE status/source and counter delta, OS-native event, stable link/interface/service evidence, clean restoration and engineer verdict for every required slot and both source positions. Tool PASS, generic dmesg text, an unmapped BDF, management-log absence, a wrong source, UCE/fatal event, reset, link degradation or service loss cannot pass.
safety_gate: Dedicated approved SUT, independent OOB path and protected production/storage/cluster traffic.
Never copy literal BDFs; correlate physical OCP identity and upstream path immediately before each stimulus.
One correctable stimulus and one source position at a time; no automatic retry.
Abort on wrong source, UCE/fatal escalation, DPC/reset, link retrain/degrade, driver loss, traffic loss or management-path impact.
expected_evidence: Signed OCP topology and interface/service dependency manifest
Tool/spec provenance, supported OS, timeout and prerequisite approval
Pre/post PCIe config, AER status/counters, link, driver, interface and service health
Separate endpoint and root-port command transcripts with exact source attribution
Restored settings and final engineer verdict per slot
test_case.recovery: Stop the injector, retain all logs, restore the exact saved AER/severity/SyncFlood/HDT/BIOS state, re-enumerate the endpoint and upstream path, verify link/interface/services through OOB, and hand any wrong-source, reset, link-loss or persistent error condition to the approved platform recovery runbook without automatic retry.

source_conflict.reason: The parameterized topology manifest, separate source checkpoints and exact AER/link/service oracle reconcile the generic hardcoded BDF conflict while preserving OCP coverage.

blocked.reason: Execution is gated, but no missing project value prevents a complete safe parameterized test definition.
